title: Creating game assets?
author: Suitable_Sport4709
selftext: Hi all, Ive spent hundreds of hours with agentic coding and various ai workflows but never tried to make a video game. I had a TTRPG I made a decade ago that I would love to bring to life as a pixel art style fantasy game and sat down to work on it last night. I couldn't believe how hard it was to make actually good looking assets! I feel like all I read is how easy vibe coding games is but I just have no idea how people are making the game look good with AI tools. Whats your process for creating the assets and world of the game? I mostly work with Claude Code and im wondering if I need yo switch to codex for the gpt image model?

comments.author: Subject-One2372
comments.body: Claude code can link to a lot of image generations just go through its /tools to start. And you can also link it to comfyui for local generation or use tripo or meshy for the best 3d generated models

replies.author: Stxxicorno
replies.body: i have been making a 2d game with trippo and meshy then turning the 3d models into sprites by taking images in 8 directions. i found this gives the most consistent characters and simple compared to trying to use h3. i still use sdxl to generate then use trippo or meshy, then i use rigify and claude to rig and animate(can use mixamo) and then take the 8 images in each direction with a shader also made by Claude.

replies.author: Suitable_Sport4709
replies.body: Interesting. Do you have an example i could see?

replies.author: aquarius8me
replies.body: How are you getting consistent images across all 8?

comments.author: kytheon
comments.body:
Don't make assets in an LLM.   
Have the LLM use an asset tool to make the assets.

comments.author: zenmatrix83
comments.body: I agreee with the other comment about making tools, but make tools that an llm can use, and you get better results then just asking the llm.

comments.author: Disastrous-Round-150
comments.body: I only do 100% from scratch zero game engine and 100% procedural zero games assets. Don't waste time on game assets use images and videos you like as reference material for procedural generation instead. 🔥

comments.author: will3dwarrior
comments.body:
If your looking to try a more iteratable style ai tool built on blender you could looks at Nalana, if nothing else skim the website for 10 seconds and see if the workflow style feels right for you but if you use meshy or tripod by all means do ur thing   
https://nalana.io

comments.author: W3103_
comments.body:
Tripo works very well but I got annoyed at the paid tiers and the ‘free’ option still involved paying for downloads 

Literally told Claude code last night to build a 3D asset generator that builds them from 2d images - and it literally one shotted it. The paint work needs manual touching up but still, it’s amazing really 

No tripo needed 🤣
